items.title: What this is
items.text:
A wall for **whatever** you want to look at.

- Paste a link, image, video or file
- Type a note, `#hex` colour, or `until 2027-01-01`
- Drag things in from anywhere

Edit `public/content.json` to change what loads first.

items.title: Plate one
items.caption: Local file in the repo, served by Cloudflare.

items.title: Ship it
items.text:
npm install
npx wrangler dev
npx wrangler deploy
